name: Apiary Manager
notes: Hives can have a queen excluder, and the hive drawing is to scale, with the box you're inspecting blinking.
Replace queen, with the queen's history and follow-up reminders, and a new Queen Needs Replacing status.
Saying "I removed this box" or "I'm taking off this box" counts as done today, and the drawing changes right away.
The Inspections tab asks you to choose a hive first.
